sources.name: FRED
sources.full_name: Federal Reserve Economic Data (St. Louis Fed)
sources.notes: Authenticated API. Requires FRED_API_KEY repo secret. Covers rates, inflation, money, employment, GDP, housing.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.notes: No auth. yfinance scrapes Yahoo's internal API. Covers equity indices, commodities, FX, crypto.

sources.name: UK Fuel (DESNZ)
sources.full_name: UK Department for Energy Security weekly road fuel prices
sources.notes: Weekly CSV. Scrapes the gov.uk landing page for the latest publication.

sources.name: UK House Prices
sources.full_name: HM Land Registry UK House Price Index
sources.notes: Probes last 6 monthly CSV URLs to find the freshest. 405 regions parsed per fetch.

sources.name: News (RSS)
sources.full_name: RSS aggregator: BBC / Reuters / FT / BoE / ECB / Fed / Guardian
sources.notes: 14/14 feeds responding. Hourly refresh in CI.

sources.name: Economic Calendar
sources.notes: Hardcoded committee dates + pattern-computed monthly releases for the next ~180 days.

sources.name: CoinGecko (live)
sources.full_name: CoinGecko Simple Price API — realtime crypto
sources.notes: Polled every 20s by the browser. Provides BTC / ETH / SOL / XRP / ATOM live prices.

sources.name: Yahoo Live (proxied)
sources.full_name: Yahoo Finance via public CORS proxy
sources.notes: Polled every 20s. Index/FX live quotes via corsproxy.io / allorigins.win fallback.

sources.name: TradingView Widget
sources.notes: Loads the live chart in the hero panel. Failure shows TradingView's own error.
